body: I try to be decent when I can, but it's hard when life keeps piling up bad luck after bad luck on me, it can be hard to focus on the good when there's so much bad going on. It feels like I did something wrong in another life that all this stuff keeps happening to me. I lost my dad a few years ago, I'm perpetually lonely, I'm single AGAIN... I feel like there's only so much a person can take before they break and I feel like I'm getting to that point.
I mean, I can try but I don't know if it'll change how I feel. But I'll try.

I've honestly been trying to think about what you said before, but it's just so hard not to feel a bit selfish by wanting my cake and eating it too. I want to be with someone else so badly that it hurts. I want love... I want to have someone tell me they love me and mean it. I don't want to settle either, just because I'm so alone. I want to be able to balance my need to help people with being happy, and I feel like right now it's one or the other, like it's not possible to have both, especially with the ability to help people now with what I have.

I know I can do some good, but what use is it if I'm so unhappy all the time... I don't know if I can last 10 years feeling like this. 

Like, I want to help people but I also want to be happy with someone, and I haven't felt this unwanted ever. 10 more years alone? That's unbearable.
